purpose: Pin the public Stage 09 baseline artifacts, safe verification commands, and candidate gates that make the current Python/FastAPI control-plane benchmark comparable with future narrow Rust data-plane candidates.
rust_scope: Rust is tracked as a future data-plane candidate for measured hot paths; not a whole-project rewrite.

contract_artifacts.role: websocket/live telemetry contract before runtime fanout
compatible report shape for Python refreshes and narrow Rust candidates
public proof that the baseline report currently passes the candidate contract
public proof that the live telemetry contract envelope, reconnect, backpressure, and runtime evidence gates are internally consistent without runtime fanout
first Rust data-plane experiment scope note for stream fanout only
fresh bounded benchmark run proves the public stable fingerprint still matches
bounded benchmark command, required outputs, and local resource envelope evidence
public proof that the pinned baseline command, required outputs, resource envelope, public paths, and Rust data-plane-only scope still agree
public proof that the baseline report remains bound to the checked-in telemetry catalog hash and stable workload identity
public headline metric index for baseline sample-rate, latency, dropped-event, target binding, blocked runtime-stream claim, and Rust data-plane-only scope
public evidence index joining baseline metric, command validation, readiness, and promotion gates without runtime fanout claims
contract-only runtime stream probe checklist before websocket fanout or a narrow Rust data-plane stream candidate can be claimed
public proof that the runtime-stream evidence checklist still matches the live contract gate, pinned proof artifacts, and baseline report bindings
public proof that each headline metric binding matches target_results.checks before runtime candidates compare metrics
review summary that confirms the baseline is comparison evidence only, keeps runtime stream claims blocked, and scopes Rust to a future data-plane candidate
promotion-readiness gate that keeps Python/FastAPI refreshes and narrow Rust stream candidates blocked until runtime probe evidence and target improvements exist
candidate metric-delta scaffold that compares target-result metrics against the public baseline and keeps baseline-as-candidate promotion blocked

required_evidence: candidate report preserves throughput_gap_profile candidate mapping
resource envelope stays within the local automation guard
at least one missed throughput target improves or a versioned workload change explains why it cannot be compared
candidate_gate.runtime_claim_rule: Do not claim websocket runtime fanout until the live telemetry contract has connection, startup snapshot, monotonic sequence, reconnect, backpressure, and stream dropped-event evidence.
